knowledge:
- key_parameters: location.type=Set to "index" to use the probe index within the probeset, or "absolute" to use actual probe locations (distances to the 3' end of the transcript) ;; location.file.dir=Required when location.type="absolute"; specifies the directory containing the pre-computed or custom probe location files (with .Rd extension) ;; chip.idx=Used in GetTongs to specify the index of the microarray chip/sample to analyze
- alternatives: The documentation mentions using vsn (Variance Stabilizing Normalization) via affy:::normalize before or after correction, and standard summarization methods like medianpolish with pmcorrect.method="pmonly" via computeExprSet as part of the microarray calibration pipeline
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing Affymetrix 3' expression microarray data where samples may have varying degrees of RNA degradation, causing probe positional bias that confounds downstream differential expression analysis
- pitfalls: When using custom probe locations, the data frame must be named exactly probeDists and contain specific columns (Probe.Set.Name of class character, and Probe.X, Probe.Y, Probe.Distance, Target.Length of class integer) ;; The custom probe location file must be saved with a filename matching the chip type identifier from cdfName(AffyBatch) and ending in .Rd

workflows.name: degradation_analysis_and_correction
workflows.intent: Assess RNA degradation, plot diagnostics, and correct probe positional bias in Affymetrix 3' expression microarrays.
input: AmpData (raw AffyBatch object representing Affymetrix 3' expression microarray data)
probeDists (optional R data frame containing custom probe locations saved as an .Rd file)
workflows.stages: 1. Visualize probe positional bias using a tongs plot ;; 2. Perform RNA degradation analysis and correction ;; 3. Plot probe degradation curves ;; 4. Access the RNA integrity parameter d ;; 5. (Optional) Save custom probe locations to an .Rd file ;; 6. Extract the corrected AffyBatch object
workflows.code:
tongs <- GetTongs(AmpData, chip.idx = 4) 
PlotTongs(tongs)
rna.deg <- RNADegradation(AmpData, location.type = "index")
plotDx(rna.deg)
d(rna.deg)
filename = paste(cdfName(AmpData), ".Rd", sep="")
save(probeDists, file = filename)
afbatch(rna.deg)

workflows.name: integrated_calibration_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform probe-level normalization using VSN, correct for probe positional bias, and compute summarized expression measures.
input: AmpData (raw AffyBatch object representing Affymetrix 3' expression microarray data)
workflows.stages: 1. Normalize raw AffyBatch data using VSN ;; 2. Correct for probe positional bias on the normalized data ;; 3. Summarize probe intensities into expression sets using median polish
workflows.code:
library(vsn)
affydata.vsn <- do.call(affy:::normalize, c(alist(AmpData, "vsn"), NULL))
affydata.vsn <- afbatch(RNADegradation(affydata.vsn))
expr <- computeExprSet(affydata.vsn, summary.method="medianpolish", pmcorrect.method="pmonly")
